cards.description_en:
At Al-Muslim Group, we are dedicated to operating a sustainable business that achieves commercial success while being socially empowering and environmentally responsible. We prioritize creating a safe and healthy workplace for our employees and fostering a culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and personal growth. Our commitment to treating all employees with dignity and respect ensures a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and victimization.

We adhere to both local and international labor laws, follow International Labour Organization (ILO) guidelines, and comply with Brand/Buyer’s Codes of Conduct in our employee relations. Our vision is to become a leading manufacturer of woven garments for global fashion brands, driven by our dedication to social and corporate responsibility.

cards.description_en: Al-Muslim Group, an apparel manufacturer based in Bangladesh, stands as a leading global provider of readymade garments and denim products. Renowned as one of the premier garment manufacturing organizations in Bangladesh, we  specialize in creating stylish and fashionable readymade garments and denim items. With a comprehensive and up-to-date manufacturing system and machinery setup, Al-Muslim Group is committed to maintaining quality standards in compliance with national and international laws.

cards.description_en:
At Al-Muslim Group, we are dedicated to operating a sustainable business that achieves commercial success while being socially empowering and environmentally responsible. We prioritize creating a safe and healthy workplace for our employees and fostering a culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and personal growth. Our commitment to treating all employees with dignity and respect ensures a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and victimization.


We adhere to both local and international labor laws, follow International Labour Organization (ILO) guidelines, and comply with Brand/Buyer’s Codes of Conduct in our employee relations. Our vision is to become a leading manufacturer of woven garments for global fashion brands, driven by our dedication to social and corporate responsibility.


Our Compliance team ensures adherence to all relevant regulations, codes, policies, and procedures. We are committed to protecting the environment by minimizing the environmental impact of our products and operations, focusing on reducing natural resource consumption through advanced technologies. Our robust compliance governance system supports the implementation and enhancement of internal controls, promoting an ethical work environment and contributing effectively to our mission.


We believe in progressing together with our society and workers. This philosophy underscores our responsibility towards our employees and the community through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives that exceed legal requirements.
